_comment: The Merkle proof wire between the Merkle proof server (`POST /v1/solana/merkle-proofs`, coprocessor/fhevm-engine/solana-merkle-proof-service/src/server.rs) and the KMS connector (kms-connector/crates/kms-worker/src/core/solana/proof.rs), as CBOR (RFC 8949) bodies in hex. `request` asks for two leaves of store ac..ac: handle 10..10 allowed to key a1..a1, and handle 11..11 made public. `response` answers found (leafIndex 1, leafCount 3, one sibling 5b..5b), notFound (leafCount 3), unknownAccount and inconsistent. Byte fields are 32-byte byte strings; maps and arrays have definite lengths. The connector encodes `request` and decodes `response` byte for byte; the server decodes `request` and encodes `response`.
